covers.scene: A street kid in baggy cargo pants, oversized hoodie, chunky sneakers and a backwards cap sits slumped in a beanbag chair, feet up on a milk crate, hands behind his head grinning while seven small robots scramble around him: one mops the floor, one types on a chunky CRT monitor, one sorts a towering stack of folders, one answers a fat brick mobile phone, one files papers into a filing cabinet, one waters a plastic plant, one shreds documents into confetti. Low angle, slightly below the kid's eye level, looking up at the chaos of busy robots. In the background, a tagged concrete wall and a busted vending machine. Skateboards, spray cans and crushed soda tins litter the floor.

Shot from a low angle at the far end of the narrow aisle, making the arm loom overhead.
covers.alt: Un brazo mecánico gigante realiza cuatro tareas de almacén a la vez en un cuarto trasero vacío.

Shot from ground level with a slight upward tilt so the hourglass towers against the background of a flat rooftop terrace at dusk, an antenna with blinking lights and three satellite dishes visible behind it.
covers.alt: Un reloj de arena gigante con listas de tareas cayendo dentro mientras un robot las recoge al pie.

covers.alt: Llave gigante y desvencijada encajada en tres candados abiertos rodeada de objetos esparcidos por el suelo

Right at the foreground, the facade of the left-side shop is physically cracking open like an eggshell, revealing a completely different interior: diagonal walls, a wild staircase spiral, a jagged rooftop shape pushing through. covers.alt: Sello industrial gigante estampando en cadena maquetas web idénticas, rodeado de objetos de personalidad sin usar.

covers.scene: Low-angle shot from ground level looking up at a young woman in an oversized zip hoodie, wide-leg cargo pants, chunky platform sneakers and a fisherman hat, frozen mid-lean with arms stretched wide and eyes bugging out, catching a waterfall of giant flat coin-tokens raining from above into her open backpack. Behind her two blocky robots with dome heads and stubby limbs are locked in a shoving match, gears and springs popping off their torsos. Ground props scattered around her: a snapped skateboard deck, three crushed cans, a fat marker and a sticker-plastered trash can, with a wall of stacked AC units filling the background.
covers.alt: Chavala Y2K atrapando monedas gigantes con la mochila abierta mientras dos robots torpes forcejean detrás.

covers.scene: Inside a cramped corner electronics shop, shot from floor level looking up at shelves towering overhead, crammed with chunky CRT monitors, bulky handheld consoles, robotic heads with blinking panel eyes and tangled cables, every item plastered with a massive circular sticker shape. The cash register on the counter hangs open, coins and paper receipt spirals launching upward in an arc. A wire display rack has toppled in the foreground, spilling boxy robot arms and chunky flip phones across the tiled floor. Through the grubby shop window: an arcade entrance showing abstract geometric shapes on its facade and a lone payphone on the pavement outside.
covers.alt: Tienda de electrónica vintage abarrotada con cachivaches por el suelo y la caja registradora escupiendo monedas.

covers.scene: Extreme low-angle close-up of two enormous coin-shaped discs smashing face-to-face in mid-air, cracking open at the impact point with microchips and stubby gears exploding outward like shrapnel, each disc face showing a different abstract embossed geometric pattern. In the immediate foreground: a chunky piggy bank molded in the shape of a robot head cracked open and toppled on its side, a shopping cart flipped upside-down and a scatter of circuit board fragments. The background shows the ribbed concrete surface of a skate plaza, a curved half-pipe ramp and a power pole wrapped in looping cables.
covers.alt: Dos monedas gigantes chocando en el aire y rompiéndose sobre una plaza de skate con chips volando.
